brief: BEST OPPORTUNITY: Turnkey LLM app templates (100+) are a gold rush—founders want deploy-ready solutions, not frameworks
TIMING: "Emerging" window—curators and template sellers are winning NOW before market saturates
BUILD THIS: White-label LLM app store with one-click deploy + monetization layer for template creators
SIGNAL: GitHub stars growing fast, developer demand for "copy-paste" AI apps is exploding post-GPT boom
EDGE: Bundle niche templates (legal, medical, finance) rather than generic catch-all—higher margins, stickier customers
